title: Email and messaging
hired_for: An owner hires the email and messaging expert to turn visitors into subscribers and subscribers into repeat buyers at almost no media cost, without landing in spam or breaking consent rules.

jobs.job: Win back shoppers who leave a full cart
jobs.why: Cart and checkout leavers are the warmest people the store has. Without a good follow-up, most never return; with a discount sent too early, margin is given away for nothing.

watch.metric: orders recovered by cart and checkout flows, matched to store orders, trailing 30 days

drives.metric: email and SMS share of store revenue

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 1 cart email with 15% off at 1 hour, recovering 4% of carts. After: 6 emails over 10 days, discount only from email 4 for first-time buyers, 7% recovered.

jobs.job: Turn new subscribers into first buyers within 72 hours
jobs.why: New sign-ups are most likely to buy in the first 3 days. A weak welcome series lets that interest fade and the paid-for sign-up is wasted.

watch.metric: welcome flow placed order rate, sign-ups from the last 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 3 welcome emails over 2 weeks, 6% of new subscribers buy. After: 6 emails front-loaded into 72 hours, 11% buy.

jobs.job: Keep emails out of the spam folder
jobs.why: If the list is full of dead contacts or the domain is not set up, sends go to spam and every flow earns less. Gmail and Yahoo now block senders who break their rules.

watch.metric: spam complaint rate and bounce rate per send, trailing 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: complaints at 0.35% and 40% of the list has not opened in 6 months. After: dead contacts sunset, complaints under 0.1%.

jobs.job: Stay inside consent and quiet hour rules on every text and email
jobs.why: Texting someone without consent or at night can bring lawsuits and fines, and one bad send can cost more than a year of SMS profit.

watch.metric: sends without valid consent and sends outside allowed local hours, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Klaviyo or SMS platform consent and send logs

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 230 texts went out after 9pm local time last month. After: quiet hours set by recipient time zone, 0 breaches.

jobs.job: Send back-in-stock alerts that match a real restock
jobs.why: People who asked to hear about a restock are ready to buy. A late alert loses them; a false one burns trust.

watch.metric: orders from back-in-stock alerts within 7 days of each restock

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: alerts fire manually 3 days after restock. After: triggered by the stock update, 22% of alerted people buy within a week.

jobs.job: Get a second order from every first-time buyer
jobs.why: Most first-time buyers never buy again. The first 30 days after order 1 decide whether the ad cost pays off.

watch.metric: share of first-time buyers who order again within 90 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 1 post-purchase email, 14% buy again in 90 days. After: a 6 step series matched to what they bought, 18%.

jobs.job: Count email revenue from real orders, not the platform's claim
jobs.why: Email tools credit themselves for any order after an open or click. The owner needs to know what email really made to decide where to spend time and money.

watch.metric: flow revenue matched to store orders against email tool reported revenue, trailing 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: Klaviyo claims 38% of revenue; order-matched it is 21%. After: the matched number is the one reported and planned on.

jobs.job: Find out each month whether a drop is traffic or a broken flow
jobs.why: Flows break quietly: a trigger stops, a code expires. Or traffic falls and flows look broken when they are not. A monthly check catches both.

watch.metric: revenue per recipient by flow against site sessions, month on month

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: cart flow revenue fell 40% and nobody knew the trigger stopped 3 weeks ago. After: flagged at the monthly check, fixed the same day.

jobs.job: Send the review request after the parcel arrives
jobs.why: Asking for a review before the product arrives gets few reviews and angry replies. Asking a few days after delivery gets more and better ones.

watch.metric: new reviews per 100 delivered orders, trailing 30 days

drives.metric: review count and product page conversion rate

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: request sent at shipment, 2 reviews per 100 orders. After: sent 3 days after delivery, 5 per 100.

jobs.job: Set up the sending domain so mail is trusted
jobs.why: Without the right domain records, big inboxes reject or spam-folder bulk mail. It is a one-time fix most stores skip.

watch.metric: sends passing domain checks, and domain reputation, trailing 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: sending from a shared domain with no policy set. After: own domain authenticated, policy moved step by step to full protection.

jobs.job: Grow the list with a pop-up and sign-up points that earn more than they annoy
jobs.why: A pop-up that fires too early or offers too much hurts site sales. One that is tuned by device grows the list without that cost.

watch.metric: pop-up sign-up rate by device and full-site conversion rate, trailing 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: pop-up on page load, 3% sign-up on mobile. After: 8 second delay, separate mobile form, 8% sign-up, site conversion flat.

jobs.job: Plan campaigns that sell without a discount every week
jobs.why: Weekly discount emails train buyers to wait for a code and cut margin on orders they would have placed anyway.

watch.metric: discount rate on email-driven orders, trailing 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 7 of 8 campaigns last month had a code, 24% average discount on email orders. After: 2 of 8, average discount 9%, revenue per recipient flat.

jobs.job: Stop sending too much, or two messages on the same day
jobs.why: When two flows and a campaign hit the same person on one day, unsubscribes jump and the list shrinks.

watch.metric: unsubscribe rate per send and contacts hit by 2 or more flows on the same day, trailing 30 days

drives.metric: list size and revenue per recipient

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 3,100 people got 2 or more flow emails on the same day last month. After: exit rules set, under 200.

jobs.job: Win back lapsed buyers at the time they usually reorder
jobs.why: A win-back sent at a default 90 days misses buyers who usually reorder at 45 or 150. Timed to the store's own cadence, it brings more back.

watch.metric: share of lapsed buyers in the win-back flow who order again, trailing 180 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: win-back fires at 90 days; median reorder is 55 days. After: fires at 70 days, 6% reactivate against 3%.

jobs.job: Recover shoppers who browsed a product and left
jobs.why: Most visitors look and leave without adding to cart. A short reminder of the exact product brings a share of them back.

watch.metric: browse abandonment placed order rate, trailing 30 days

drives.metric: email and SMS share of store revenue

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: no browse flow. After: 4 emails linking to the viewed product, 1.5% of recipients buy.

jobs.job: Write emails that get clicked, not just opened
jobs.why: Opens are no longer a reliable number. Short, skimmable emails with one clear action and live text earn the click that leads to the sale.

watch.metric: click rate per send, trailing 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: image-only emails with 6 products, 0.9% click rate. After: live text, 3 products, one button, 1.5%.

jobs.job: Make SMS earn more than it costs
jobs.why: Each text costs money. SMS sent too often or to buyers who never click can cost more than it makes and drive opt-outs.

watch.metric: SMS revenue matched to store orders minus SMS send cost, monthly

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: $2,400 a month on texts, $3,100 of matched revenue. After: sends cut to high-intent moments, $1,300 cost and $3,400 revenue.

jobs.job: Keep every urgency and stock claim in emails true
jobs.why: Fake sell-out or last-chance lines break trust and can break consumer law. Buyers notice when last chance happens every week.

watch.metric: sends with a stock, deadline or price claim not backed by store data, trailing 30 days
watch.source: brand brain scan against Shopify inventory and discounts

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 'almost gone' sent on a product with 900 units. After: 0 unbacked claims; scarcity lines tied to real stock counts.

jobs.job: Get more email subscribers to opt in to text
jobs.why: Text reaches people email misses, for urgent moments like a restock or a cart. Asking at the right step after email sign-up doubles opt-ins.

watch.metric: share of email subscribers who also opt in to SMS, current
watch.source: Klaviyo or SMS platform consent log

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 8% of subscribers take text. After: phone asked as a second step to unlock the offer, 20%.

jobs.job: Cut returns with how-to and fit-check emails after purchase
jobs.why: Many returns come from wrong fit or wrong use. A short email before the product arrives can stop the return.

watch.metric: return rate on orders that got the post-purchase how-to or fit email versus those that did not, trailing 60 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 11% of first orders returned for fit. After: fit-check email before delivery, 8.5%.

jobs.job: Remind buyers to reorder when they are about to run out
jobs.why: For products that get used up, a reminder timed to days of supply plus delivery keeps the buyer from trying a rival.

watch.metric: reorder rate among reminded buyers within 30 days of the reminder

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: no reminder; median reorder at 70 days on a 45 day supply. After: reminder at day 38, 24% reorder within 30 days.

jobs.job: Treat the best customers so they notice
jobs.why: Top customers bring a large share of profit. Perks they never hear about do not keep them.

watch.metric: orders per top 10% customer over 180 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: VIP tier exists, 1 email a year mentions it. After: tier-up, points and birthday messages live; VIP orders per 180 days from 2.1 to 2.5.

jobs.job: Move revenue from one-off campaigns into always-on flows
jobs.why: Campaigns need work every week. Flows earn every day with no extra work. Stores that rely on campaigns stall when the team is busy.

watch.metric: flow share of email revenue, trailing 30 days

drives.metric: email revenue per hour of team time (proxy)

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: flows make 25% of email revenue. After: 6 core flows built out, flows at 50%.

jobs.job: Keep segments current so the right people get each send
jobs.why: Segments built once and never checked send winter offers to summer buyers and VIP perks to people who churned.

watch.metric: days since each segment was last checked, and revenue per recipient in the engaged segment

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: engaged segment rules untouched for 14 months. After: reviewed each quarter, revenue per recipient up 15%.

jobs.job: Run email tests that give a real answer
jobs.why: Tests on button colour or tests stopped after a day teach nothing. Tests on timing and offer, judged by orders, move money.

watch.metric: tests with a pre-set winning metric that produced a real win, trailing 6 months
watch.source: Klaviyo and brand brain test log

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 9 tests in 6 months, all on subject lines, judged on opens. After: 6 tests on delay and offer, judged on placed orders, 2 clear wins.
